title: Avoid hash-based containers of java.net.URL–the containers rely on equals() and hashCode(), which cause java.net.URL to make blocking internet connections.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: URLs should not be used in @see tags; they are designed for Java elements which could be used with @link.
summary: It is an experimental check, so Error Prone does not turn it on by default.
